2 Things You Need To Know

1. We may not use the GRP but anyone listed on this page is in GRP, I have EMD after my name because that is my clan in other games (specifically the command and conquer series).

2. You risk yourself posting in the forums or talking to us, anything stupid may result in serious flamming, and I may be flaming with them, cause you probably deserved it. Anyway, have fun.
-aswedEMD


Important Notes

For anyone wanting to join in our guild, post on the guild website forum found in the box on the right (yes the forum part is up) or find me, aswedEMD, on Dungeon Runners, there we will set up a time where you will run a dungeon with us and we see how you do, we wish that you be between level 20 and 45 but is not officially required (we do not power level if that is what you want). There is no guarantee that you will be in the guild but hopefully we can work something out.

The guild webpage is not complete yet, we are currently working and will be done within the next month.

I am aware that some people are having issues connecting to the IRC channel, this is a server problem and it is not one that I can deal with very well on my own, I'm currently searching for a solution and will post more when I get it resolved. Thank you for your patience.
